IndependentStudentMathQuestions.IndependentStudentQuestion: How does parametric point plotting differ from Cartesian y=f(x)?

IndependentStudentMathQuestions.IndependentStudentQuestion: What do arrows on parametric curves represent?

IndependentStudentMathQuestions.IndependentStudentQuestion: Name three common parametric graph types.

IndependentStudentMathQuestions.IndependentStudentQuestion: Why parametric graphs help with projectiles?
